Rally is agentic user research infrastructure. Our agent runs recruitment end to end, from finding participants through scheduling and sending incentives. Underneath, our infrastructure enforces the guardrails enterprises require: consent, permissions, templates, data governance, and more. Trusted by teams building the future of product research: Google, Meta, Ramp, Figma, and Perplexity.

Talk to your users today with Rally.
